note: Raw skeleton for full-grade diagnostics inside the tutor library. NO items, NO sampling logic, NO UI wiring yet. Each grade declares 5 diagnostic forms: 3 'sampled' (to be assembled from already-verified library quiz/cluster-test items) and 2 'new-material' (net-new authored + verified). Meant to mirror the public /curriculum/ tests (timer + PDF) but tutor-only (no email gate).
mirrors: /curriculum/ test model (per-grade config + questions[]); config values here are copied from curriculum/data/*.json
scope: 29 grade-subjects (K-12 ELA, K-8 + named HS math). SAT excluded (test-prep, not a grade).
